description: This file is a script used for analyzing a codebase for architectural smells, particularly in TypeScript source files. It imports various utility modules, defines functions to scan source files for specific patterns indicating architecture issues, and provides entry points for executing these checks and outputting results in human-readable or JSON formats.

methods.name: compareEntries
methods.description: Compares two entries based on category, file, line, kind, specifier, and reason for sorting purposes.

methods.name: pushEntry
methods.description: Adds a new entry to the entries array.

methods.name: scanPluginSdkExtensionFacadeSmells
methods.description: Scans a source file for plugin SDK extension facade re-export patterns indicating architecture smells.

methods.name: scanRuntimeTypeImplementationSmells
methods.description: Detects direct references from runtime type files to implementation shim files, indicating potential architecture issues.

methods.name: scanRuntimeServiceLocatorSmells
methods.description: Checks for patterns related to runtime service locator and module-global state which may violate architecture guidelines.

methods.name: collectArchitectureSmells
methods.description: Main function that collects all detected architecture smells from project files.

methods.name: formatInventoryHuman
methods.description: Formats the collected architecture smells into a human-readable string.

methods.name: runArchitectureSmellsCheck
methods.description: Runs the architecture smell check and outputs the results in JSON or human-readable format.

methods.name: main
methods.description: Main entry point for the script execution.
